stages.guard: new grant, fresh target/source/artifact/predecessor binding and same grant boot; safe absent owned paths
stages.operation: Read current target/boot/package DB/source manifest and sidecar, archive identities, payload/backend IDs and absent owned/publication paths against new grant; buffer early streams in memory; consume grant on invocation.

stages.guard: EXIT/HUP/INT/TERM cleanup registered before first filesystem mutation
stages.operation: Register EXIT/HUP/INT/TERM dispatcher with original status, reentrancy state and unset owned-root flags; no filesystem lock or logging before this barrier.

stages.guard: create exclusive owned evidence/temp roots; record partial construction on failure
stages.operation: Exclusive mkdir0700 after traps; set owned-root-created immediately; create stage journals, verified immutable payload copies, adapter directory and private WORKDIR/TEMP; preserve partial construction.

stages.guard: capture exact production baseline bytes, modes and owner before package/config writes
stages.operation: Copy config/mirrors/state with original metadata, capture header names/content, package record bytes, GenInitrd presence and boot/source/history fingerprints; compare all backups before setting backup_ready.

stages.guard: use separately validated exact predecessor artifact; no unrelated package action
stages.operation: Recheck new grant boot and exact predecessor SHA/path; upgradepkg exact predecessor only; compare package record delta to target-header-only predecessor transition.

stages.guard: use reviewed local v4 URI and isolated state; forbid external network during refresh/apply
stages.operation: Derive config as data into owned path, optional modules disabled, core work/log/lock owned; set CHECKGPG=off, WORKDIR/TEMP owned and one exact file URI in temporary production Slackpkg config/mirrors; compare derived keys and source SHA.

Run real Slackpkg update inside network namespace with no fallback; record complete streams/exit; require absent-before fresh regular nonempty pkglist, reject human-spaced download error in both streams.

stages.guard: one exact eight-field target row; same-transaction source/pkglist/archive hashes before apply
stages.operation: Extract immutable accepted candidate oracle by AST in implementation design; validate one exact eight-field target row, zero unrelated candidates, source/archive/pkglist SHA; persist binding owned to same transaction.

stages.guard: only reviewed exact payload, after target-only binding; no boot or unrelated candidates
stages.operation: Use immutable reviewed reference under network namespace and sanitized env; guarded Slackpkg adapter rechecks binding before EVERY internal update/install-new/upgrade-all, validates post-update identical bound pkglist, and captures nested evidence.

stages.guard: restore target baseline header, config/mirrors/state and owned temporary changes
stages.operation: Idempotent dispatcher restores verified config/mirrors/state/header baseline using whitelisted paths and verified backups; removes only explicitly owned mutable work/cache/lock paths; keeps evidence and backups.

stages.guard: verify header names/content, unrelated package records, config/state/GenInitrd/boot and preserved inputs
stages.operation: Compare original header names/content, unrelated records, config/mirrors bytes/owner/modes, state, GenInitrd, boot and source/history; restoration complete flag only after all match.

stages.guard: per-stage stdout/stderr/exit, original failure/signal and cleanup outcomes; preserve failure evidence
stages.operation: Complete all known per-stage stream/exit/signal and cleanup evidence; unknown statuses remain null; no original status overwritten; preserve failure evidence and pending obligations.

stages.guard: success only after all guards/restoration/evidence; failure/none never success
stages.operation: Prepare exclusive archive and sidecar without overwrite; external publication receipt records last-stage stdout/stderr/exit and final eligibility; receipt commits last; no self-containing archive or atomic pair claim.
